name: Pizzeria Da Capo
kurzbeschreibung:
**Pizzeria Da Capo in Tirol**

Welcome to **Pizzeria Da Capo** in the heart of **Tirol**, where authentic Italian flavors meet the charm of the Alps. Whether you're craving a classic **Margherita**, a hearty **Diavola**, or a delicious **Quattro Formaggi**, our handmade pizzas are baked to perfection in a traditional wood-fired oven.

Indulge in our fresh pasta dishes, from creamy **Fettuccine Alfredo** to tangy **Penne all’Arrabbiata**, all made with the finest ingredients. For a taste of **Tirol**, try our seasonal specialties like **Kaiserschmarrn** with fresh berries or a warm **Apfelstrudel**—perfect with a cup of **Tiroler Bergkäse** or a frothy **Schnaps**.

Sip on a fine **Espresso** or a refreshing **Aperol Spritz** while enjoying the cozy atmosphere. Whether you're visiting **Innsbruck**, exploring the **Zillertal**, or taking a break in **Kitzbühel**, **Pizzeria Da Capo** is your go-to spot for a memorable dining experience.

Come for the food, stay for the warmth—**Benvenuti a Da Capo!**
